denominator: All display cells in this rectangular geographic window, including water and any unrelated land. Not administrative land coverage.

status_legend.0: No source observation among selected scenes (transparent)
status_legend.1: Observed but no accepted clear pixel (transparent); includes cloud/shadow/cirrus, unclassified, saturated/snow or mask-edge rejection

processing.rgb: Native 10m TCI display values (uint8) read by HTTP Range and bilinear reprojected. No reflectance scaling applied to TCI.
processing.scl: Mask warp uses explicit false=1,true=2 to prevent zero exclusion by statistical resampling; threshold1.999. Read native 20m SCL. Accept classes2,4,5,6. Reject0,1,3,7,8,9,10,11. Dilate cloud/shadow/cirrus classes3,8,9,10 by3native pixels(60m); require >=99.9% clear fraction for each output cell. For broad main-island preview only, conservative4x4 all-clear blocks reduce native20m mask to80m before reprojection; observed mask uses any-observed blocks.
processing.mosaic: First accepted pixel in scene cloud%+0.35*nodata% rank order. Multi-date best-available display; not a median, single-date image, or independently certified cloud-free product.
processing.cloud_audit_limit: SCL may miss haze/thin cloud or misclassify land/water; overviews and resampling lower display detail. Remaining holes stay transparent. Counts cover selected candidates only, not all 2025 observations.
